title: Rory and the Canyon of Glowing Stones
verses:
When stars started blinking above in the deep,
While Rory walked slowly along through the glade.
The valley was folding itself into sleep,
Beneath the soft blue that the dusk had just made.

Then Nia swooped down from a high rocky hill,
While Psittaco chirped from a hollow of pine.
The air in the canyon was cozy and still,
Where stones in the darkness were starting to shine.

Now Ricky stepped softly on cushions of moss,
And Benny sighed happily, closing his eyes.
A gentle breeze drifted and fluttered across,
To whisper a song beneath twinkling skies.

Then Tilly scooped leaves into piles on the floor,
To make a warm nest that was roomy and deep.
Outside in the canyon the winds blew no more,
As all of the valley was drifting to sleep.

Now Psittaco nestled on Benny’s wide side,
And Nia tucked wings in the glow of the cave.
The night was a blanket spread heavy and wide,
Above the calm pool and its quietest wave.

Then Rory lay down with his chin on his paws,
Content in the quiet that settled around.
The forest was hushed in a magical pause,
While dreams drifted in without making a sound.
